annotation.title_clean: Blueprint for an AI Bill of Rights: Making Automated Systems Work for the American People
annotation.title_en: Blueprint for an AI Bill of Rights: Making Automated Systems Work for the American People
annotation.authors_or_issuer: White House Office of Science and Technology Policy (OSTP)
annotation.summary_en: Non-binding White House OSTP white paper setting out five principles for automated systems: safe and effective systems, algorithmic discrimination protections, data privacy, notice and explanation, and human alternatives. It includes a technical companion with practical steps. General AI civil-rights framing with no robotics-specific provisions.
key_provisions_or_claims: Five principles: safe and effective systems; algorithmic discrimination protections; data privacy; notice and explanation; human alternatives, consideration and fallback
Non-binding; creates no legal rights and does not change existing law or agency policy
Technical companion gives concrete steps for governments and companies
Calls for pre-deployment testing, risk identification, ongoing monitoring and public reporting
Heightened protections for sensitive domains such as health, employment, education and criminal justice
